segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: May I now recognize the Representative from the Minority, Representative Sheen Gonzales.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Mr. Chair. Magandang hapon po sa ating lahat, to my colleagues, sa DA family, headed by Sec. Kiko Laurel.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Bago po ako magtanong ng ilang mga questions, gusto ko pong magpasalamat sa ating Department of Agriculture Secretary sa mga programa po na binibigay doon sa probinsya po ng Eastern Samar, sa Long District of Eastern Samar.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Ang dami na po yung natulungan doon and nagpapasalamat din po ako sa mga darating pa ng mga tulong na ibibigay po sa probinsya po ng Eastern Samar.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Mayroon lang po akong ilang katanungan sa BIFAR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Noong last year, nagkaroon po kami ng pagpupulong at during the budget season also, budget hearing, mayroon pong pinag-usapan at nag-pledge po ang ating BIFAR na magkakaroon po ng rehabilitation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: yung research and training center ng region.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: At ito po ay nasa Giwan, Eastern Samar.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Alam ko po yung lugar na to kasi dito po ako pinanganak sa lugar na to at nag-mayor din po ako dito sa bayan na to.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Simula po ng mabagyo ng Yolanda, hindi pa po ito natutotal rehab.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Si Director Aziz Perez, siya po pa po yung director noon, ng time ng Yolanda.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Hindi pa po ito natutotal rehab pero nagsabi po yung BIFAR last year na magkakaroon po ng pondo at i-rehab po nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: So, ang tanong ko lang po Mr. Chair, with the good secretary, even the BIFAR through Director Toto, gusto ko lang po itanong ano po kaya ang status na nito?

segments.speaker: BFAR Director Elizer S. Salilig
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Chair. May ongoing na po tayo rehab doon.

segments.speaker: BFAR Director Elizer S. Salilig
segments.text: And there po sa national program.

segments.speaker: BFAR Director Elizer S. Salilig
segments.text: The Fisheries Department Institute of Research, and there po kay Director Mutia.

segments.speaker: BFAR Director Elizer S. Salilig
segments.text: Sir, naka-concept na sila worth 5 million but kung anong kulang po, willing po ang BIFAR mag-support sa pinansyal.

segments.speaker: BFAR Director Elizer S. Salilig
segments.text: Nandito po rin ating Director po, iniparty ay, pwede rin siya magbigay ng kanyang opinion na talagang ginagawa na namin yung Seryom Khan, yung project.

segments.speaker: BFAR Director Elizer S. Salilig
segments.text: Please, with the permission of the Chair.

segments.speaker: BFAR Director Elizer S. Salilig
segments.text: Thank you, Sir.

segments.speaker: NFRDI Executive Director Maria Theresa M. Mutia
segments.text: Hello, Mr. Chair. Ako po si Maris Mutia, ang currently Executive Director of National Fisheries Research and Development Institute.

segments.speaker: NFRDI Executive Director Maria Theresa M. Mutia
segments.text: Sa kasalukuyan po ay meron po kaming nailaan na about 10.6 million po para po sa rehabilitation ng research facilities po sa Giwan Summer po.

segments.speaker: NFRDI Executive Director Maria Theresa M. Mutia
segments.text: And meron din po counterpart doon, ang BIFAR, around 2.5 million. So ongoing po yun, i-improve po natin yung ating research facilities, yung ating laboratory, dormitory, abalone, hatchery, at iba pa pong facilities.

segments.speaker: NFRDI Executive Director Maria Theresa M. Mutia
segments.text: Matatapos po yun by October po this year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Yes, thank you, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: NFRDI Executive Director Maria Theresa M. Mutia
segments.text: Ito po ay phase one pa lang po.

segments.speaker: NFRDI Executive Director Maria Theresa M. Mutia
segments.text: Ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Thank you po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Mr. Chair. Maraming salamat, ma'am.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Pwede po ba akong makahingi ng rehabilitation plan nyo?

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Kasi kailangan po dito yung total rehab. Mahirap po yung pachi-pachi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Kasi it is the research and training center of the whole region. Nandun po ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Paano tayo makakapag-produce o makakapag-produce?

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Makakapag-pakita na maganda po ang kahihinat na ng Region 8 in terms of research and development with regards to BIFAR kung hindi po ito maaayos ng tama.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Can I ask the BIFAR family to give me the total rehabilitation plan?

segments.speaker: NFRDI Executive Director Maria Theresa M. Mutia
segments.text: Opo.

segments.speaker: NFRDI Executive Director Maria Theresa M. Mutia
segments.text: Mr. Chair, we will submit po.

segments.speaker: NFRDI Executive Director Maria Theresa M. Mutia
segments.text: Yung rehabilitation plan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Mr. Chair, thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Yung pangalawang question ko po, yung mandato po ng ating mahal na Pangulo to the department is food sufficiency.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: In other words, sa bawat Pilipino, kailangan secure po yung pagkain.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Address naman po ito sa NIA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Alam ko po na may mga rehabilitasyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: May mga programang rehabilitasyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: At sa programang ito, nagbaba kasakali or ako po ay nangihihin ng intervention sa ating administrator na mapasama sa listahan ng pag-rehabilitate po ng Dolores Valley, also called the Sikonton Valley Irrigation Facilities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Ito po ay located sa Dolores Eastern City.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Ang lugar po ito, ito po ay rice granary ng probinsya ng Eastern Samar.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: At hindi lang po ito nagbibigay ng pag-asa sa mga taga Eastern Samar.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: At hindi lang po ito nakakapagbigay ng ating pagkain sa Eastern Samar, kundi sa buong Region 8, once upon a time, being the rice granary,

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: ay naging asset po ito ng ating...

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: regiyon, ng aming regiyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: So yung sa akin po, if you have any intervention or meron po kayong plano to rehabilitate that area.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Actually, totoo yun. Napakaganda po nung area ng ating kagahanagalan na congressman.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: And meron po tayong proposal doon, meron po tayong plano doon, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: At we hope to implement that also.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Next year, ang hindi lamang yun, tinignan namin pati yung mga areas doon, yung mga hindi pa natatapos na mga irrigation projects po doon,

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: pinapatapos na ng Pangulo, yung sa may katubig.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: So lahat po nung sa area ng Samar, Mr. Chair, ay tinitignan natin at ginagawa natin.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Kasi totoo nung nga naman, napakaganda po yung area, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Salamat po, Admin. At napakaganda pong pakinggan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: At committed naman po tayo na i-rehabilita yung lugar na yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: At hinding-hindi po kayo magsisisi dyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Pag yan ay na-rehabilita, makikita nyo po ang kabuhayan ng tao at ang probinsya ng Sinlangan Samar ay mag-i-increase yung hanap buhay at ang tinatawag na GDP growth ng probinsya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Ay sigurado ako na mag-i-increase po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: My last question, Mr. Chair. Actually, I will not ask question anymore.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Kasi yung time ko, tumunog na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Yung sa akin na lang po, Mr. Chair, yung mga programa ng Department of Agriculture, ipagpatuloy na lang po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Kasi sa probinsya ng Eastern Samar, alam naman po natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: yung fishing industry at saka mga farmland po doon, ay umaasa po ang mga tao natin doon, Mr. Chair, Secretary.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Chair, bababaho ako personally sa Eastern Samar sa October with BIFAR and yung ibang members of my team para magbigay ng dagdag na suporta at makita yung actual situation in the ground

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: para mas masilbihan pa sila sa 2021.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Dagang salamat, damang salamat, Secretary and the DA family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: God bless.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Mr. Chair, sorry. Alright, thank you, Mr. Chair. Secretary, magandang hapon po.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: First of all, I would like to thank you for visiting my district and for providing us with one of the biggest warehouse facility in the province of Iloilo.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: I was just talking to our regional director with respect to the rice processing facility that your department, your office, has committed since three years ago, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: So far, tatlong taon na yung lumipas. Hanggang ngayon, Sec, the project has yet to be implemented.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: I recall that in 2023, this was committed under ODA by Yusec Jerome.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Pero hanggang ngayon, as I was talking to Regional Director Arpia, late last year, yung buong farmers organization and cooperatives in the municipality of Dumangas,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: which happens to be the biggest, the largest produced rice.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: The biggest producing municipality in the entire Panay region, Panay Island, he promised to download the farm equipment from Philmec.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Lahat po, Sec, ng mga requirements including FS, including audited financial statements, were all complied with.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Pero hanggang ngayon, I just want to seek the guidance of the good secretary.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Kung kailan talaga?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Kung kailan talaga ito, Sec, ma-implement. Kasi may warehouse na tayo, pero wala pa rin tayong rice processing facility.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Chair, I'm, well, technically, pasensya na kayo at na-delay talaga yung project ninyo.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: But since bumaba ako doon the last time at I coordinated with Philmec, palagang meron na naka-alat sa inyong RPS.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: And I would like to ask our...

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: I would like to ask our Philmec director to give you the actual timelines na now para matapos na ho yan, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: PhilMech Director IV Dionisio G. Alvindia, Ph.D.
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. Magandang gabi po, Mr. Congressman.

segments.speaker: PhilMech Director IV Dionisio G. Alvindia, Ph.D.
segments.text: Actually, yung warehouse na itatayo natin doon sa inyo, ang floor area niya ay 1,200 square meters.

segments.speaker: PhilMech Director IV Dionisio G. Alvindia, Ph.D.
segments.text: At yung bidding ng warehouse, nakapost na this month, sinisimula na po.

segments.speaker: PhilMech Director IV Dionisio G. Alvindia, Ph.D.
segments.text: Ngayon, yung 1,200 square meters na yun.

segments.speaker: PhilMech Director IV Dionisio G. Alvindia, Ph.D.
segments.text: Ang kanyang kasama ay 12 tonners na dryer.

segments.speaker: PhilMech Director IV Dionisio G. Alvindia, Ph.D.
segments.text: Then, pagka po natapos yung warehouse, next year, lalagyan po natin ang rice processing system 2,

segments.speaker: PhilMech Director IV Dionisio G. Alvindia, Ph.D.
segments.text: na ang capacity niya ay 3 tons per hour ang input capacity po niya.

segments.speaker: PhilMech Director IV Dionisio G. Alvindia, Ph.D.
segments.text: Thank you, po.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: To add lang, Mr. Chair, kailan yung timeline natin matatapos?

segments.speaker: PhilMech Director IV Dionisio G. Alvindia, Ph.D.
segments.text: Doon po sa mga contractor natin, binibigyan po natin sila ng...

segments.speaker: PhilMech Director IV Dionisio G. Alvindia, Ph.D.
segments.text: ng 150 days para po matapos yung warehouse.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: So, Mr. Chair, I think the commitment is by June next year, dapat tapos siya.

segments.speaker: PhilMech Director IV Dionisio G. Alvindia, Ph.D.
segments.text: Yes, sir.

segments.speaker: PhilMech Director IV Dionisio G. Alvindia, Ph.D.
segments.text: Pati po yung rice processing system, nandun na rin po, Mr. Com.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Mr. Chair, Mr. Secretary, I would like to be clarified lang, ano.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Itong mga equipment that goes with the rice processing system,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: kapasity of 3 tons per day, is that correct, Mr. Secretary?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Mr. Chair, 3 tons per hour po.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Sorry, 3 tons per hour, yes, I'm corrected.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: So, tama ba, Mr. Secretary, Mr. Chair, that the equipment that are included in the facility

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: would be the following, 4-wheel drive tractor, 4 units, laser leveler, 1 unit,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: combined harvester.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: 4 units, flatbed dryer, 4 units, forklift, 2 units, hauling truck, 2 units,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: and conveyor elevator, 2 units.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Tama ba, Mr. Secretary?

segments.speaker: PhilMech Director IV Dionisio G. Alvindia, Ph.D.
segments.text: Tama po, yun po ang request niyo, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: PhilMech Director IV Dionisio G. Alvindia, Ph.D.
segments.text: Pero yun pong, yung hauling trucks po ay nakikipag-negotiate pa rin po kami sa DBM

segments.speaker: PhilMech Director IV Dionisio G. Alvindia, Ph.D.
segments.text: kasi until now, hindi pa po kami binibigyan ng go-signal to purchase

segments.speaker: PhilMech Director IV Dionisio G. Alvindia, Ph.D.
segments.text: sa DBM.

segments.speaker: PhilMech Director IV Dionisio G. Alvindia, Ph.D.
segments.text: So, yung 4-wheel drive tractors, yung combined harvesters, saka po yung mga whaling scale

segments.speaker: PhilMech Director IV Dionisio G. Alvindia, Ph.D.
segments.text: nung lahat ng kasama doon sa warehouses at saka doon sa rice processing system, kasama

segments.speaker: PhilMech Director IV Dionisio G. Alvindia, Ph.D.
segments.text: po yun.

segments.speaker: PhilMech Director IV Dionisio G. Alvindia, Ph.D.
segments.text: Maliba lang po doon sa hauling trucks.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Okay, because according to the regional director, Mr. Secretary, these equipment have yet to

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: be bid out.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Wala pa daw pera.

segments.speaker: PhilMech Director IV Dionisio G. Alvindia, Ph.D.
segments.text: Mr. Chair, tapos na po yung bidding namin sa tractors, saka 4-wheel drive, at saka yung rice combined harvesters,

segments.speaker: PhilMech Director IV Dionisio G. Alvindia, Ph.D.
segments.text: at iro-roll out na po namin yan ang aming timetable para doon sa distribution niya na ay October, November, December this year.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: So, the commitment of the Secretary is the entire facility, including the aforesaid equipment,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: will all be delivered by June of next year.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Is that correct, Mr. Secretary?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Chair, the RPS will be committed on June 2027, pero uunahin na natin yung tractors and combined

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: harvesters itong November, October, November, December kung saan pumasok yung, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: So, since this is long overdue, malamang pupunta kami mismo para at kasama kayo at namin yan,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: At nilista ko na sa aking notebook, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Naniniwala naman tayo sa commitment ng ating butihing Secretary.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Thank you, SEC, for that assurance, and we look forward to receiving the entire facility in the municipality of Dumangas.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: I will move to my next question to Usec Palabrica, may kababayan.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Usec, if you recall last year, I raised the issue on the safety and efficacy of your vaccine that you're using for,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: may I know if you have already completed the entire clinical trial, a conclusive study that would attest to the efficacy and safety of your ASF vaccine?

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Constante J. Palabrica
segments.text: Mr. Chair, yes.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Constante J. Palabrica
segments.text: We were able to

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Constante J. Palabrica
segments.text: distribute half a million of ASF vaccine, and the efficacy is 85 to

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Constante J. Palabrica
segments.text: 90 percent, and all those pigs that were vaccinated showed good response.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.

segments.text: Representative Carl Nicolas Cari. Thank you, Mr. Chair, to our Secretary and

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: the Department. Magandang gabi po sa ating lahat. Ito pong mga katanungan po ng aming

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: representasyon

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: ay naka-focus po sa mga nangyayari ngayon dulot ng climate change, global warming,

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: at gusto lang po namin malaman kung gaano po kahanda ang Departamento ukol po sa mga pagbabago

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: ng klima na nagdudulot po ng mas malalang epekto sa atin pong mga

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: magsasaka. At una pong tanong: base sa datos ng DA, gaano na kalaki ang epekto ng pagbabago ng panahon sa ating

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: mga magsasaka kumpara noong 20 years ago?

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: Nakakasabay ba ang programs at resources ng DA sa pagbabago ng risks na hinaharap ng ating farmers?

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: kubara nung 20 years ago nakakasabay ba ang programs at resources ng D.A. sa pagbabago ng risks na hinaharap ng ating farmers?

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: The question is directed to the Secretary. Anyone who can answer po?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Well, Mr. Chair, climate change is very real and nararamdaman po natin ngayon ang mga nangyayari.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Unfortunately, I cannot say na nakakasabay tayo sa pagbabago ng klima dahil nga I have to admit na hindi ganun kabilis ang reaction ng gobyerno

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: dahil whatever we experience now or what we learn from now, ngayon lang natin, hihingin lang natin yung budget ngayon para for implementation next year.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Para nga ma-address yun. But of course, meron na tayong naging El Nino, three years ago ba?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Two years ago, no? So yung mga natutunan natin during that time ay ina-apply na natin ngayon, no?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: So things should get better but to catch up is really hard.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Some of the interventions na ginagawa nga natin is yung cold storages na tinatayo natin.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: May mga mega cold storage, mga modular cold storage na tayong nakabit.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: May mga solar irrigation ng NIA na ginawa.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: At meron din ng DA ngayon na ini-implement na solar irrigation.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: We are implementing solar pumps also instead of engine-driven pumps sa ating mga farms.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: At for next year naman, para sa mga aquaculture at fisheries, mga solar-powered aerators naman

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: para ma-address natin yung fish kill due to low water or stagnant water among others.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Marami pa po tayong ginagawa, no? Like a small water impounding.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: At of course, technology ng seeds na mas malakas sa dry conditions.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: At of course, meron din tayong mga tinatawag na protective cultivation systems,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: basically mga greenhouses para ngayon magkaroon tayo ng shield sa mga heavy rains and floods

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: para tuloy-tuloy ang produksyon.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: So tuloy-tuloy naman ang implementation natin ng mga ito to try to cope up with the,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: you know, changes sa ating klima, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: Pangalawang tanong po, kapag napinsala ang mga sakahan dahil sa pagbaha, pag-uho ng lupa o iba pang epekto ng masamang panahon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: ano pong financial assistance ang agad pong available na may bibigay po natin sa mga magsasaka

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: para makapagsimula ulit po sila sa susunod na planting season?

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: And gano'n po kaya kabilis ang narating na tulong ito sa mga affected na family farmers natin?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Chair, meron tayong Philippine Crop Insurance, no?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: But of course, kailangan mag-apply ang farmer every cropping season para makover sila nito.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Normally, within 21 days after tamaan ng farm,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: nakakapag-issue na tayo ng indemnity check sa ating mga farmers that are affected, no?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: But of course, not all. Meron talagang mga ilan na nade-delay kasi nga verification and all of that.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Meron din tayong mga support system.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Support ng seeds and fertilizers to replant.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Normally, nasa regional centers na yan, para for deployment, katulad ngayon sa mga baha na inabot natin dito sa Region 3,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: meron na tayong nakaprepare na seeds and fertilizers para makareplant ka agad, among others.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Meron din tayong loan program sa SURE na up to, I think, 35,000 pwedeng low-interest loan na makakuha ang farmer

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: para makarecover.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Meron din tayong programa ng loan restructuring sa kanila.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: At worst case scenario, nagbibigay din tayo ng presidential assistance to farmers and fisher folks,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: but unfortunately for this year, medyo naubos na.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Pero humihingi tayong nagdagdag pa from the national government.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Then, meron din tayong tupad na inallocate sa DA para sa mga affected farmers.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Dito sa mga climate changes kung kinakailangan, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: Isa pa pong katanungan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: Pagkatapos ng matinding pagbaha, paano tinutulungan ng DA ang mga magsasaka natin na malaman kung handa na ba ulit ang kanilang lupa for planting?

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: May libre of subsidized bang soil testing at technical assistance?

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: At gaano ito maka-accessible sa mga magsasaka po natin?

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: Sa ngayon, we have the...

segments.text: We have, Mr. Chair, 17 mobile soil laboratories aside from the existing land-based...

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: fixed-based solar laboratories na pwedeng i-access ng mga other farmers.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Although, I have to admit na kulang pa ito at the volume we can process is hindi ganun ka...

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Malaki na rin compared to...

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Dating lima lang yan eh. Ngayon nasa mga 20 plus na eh.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: So, malaking rami yung dinadagdag natin.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: But still kulang pa rin.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: But libre ito as of the moment.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: At pwedeng magpa-test ang mga farmers natin.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: But normally naman pag after a bagyo, ang lupa naman normally pwedeng taniman kaagad eh.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Basta lang nag-receive na yung baha.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: So, but soil testing is always good to be more accurate sa pangangailangan ng lupa para maka-save din ang cost, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: Thank you po, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: And for our final question po, this is related to our advocacy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: Kami po sa Pinoy Workers is very supportive of our fisherfolk and farmers in the West Philippine Sea.

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: Dahil po ako personal taga-Palawan po ako, kaya this is close to our heart po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: And yung katanungan lang po for the fishing communities in Palawan, particularly those dependent on the fishing grounds in our West Philippine Sea,

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: what livelihood and production support will be available in this coming budget...

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: in the 2027 budget?

segments.text: And how does BEFAR, if that is the case, plan to improve access to assistance such as fuel, ice, fishing gear, insurance, and market support?

segments.text: Mr. Chair, sa Palawan, meron tayong bagong port na ginagawa ng Philippine Fisheries Development Authority sa Puerto Princesa area, no?

segments.text: Para tas itatransport nalang by land to that port, that new port, which should be finished by next year.

segments.text: Magtatayo tayo ng bagong bioreactor facility rin by this year, hopefully, for planting material, propagation of planting material sa seaweed sa Palawan.

segments.text: Meron na tayo sa Sorsogon, may Palawan tayo, at meron pa isang location, I forgot lang kung saan.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: But Palawan is, definitely we want to increase yung seaweed production natin sa Palawan para yung mga mga isda,

segments.text: pwede rin mag-aalaga ng kanilang seaweeds.

segments.text: Meron din tayong livestock program na ipapamahagi like mga kambing at tupa sa mga fisher folks na may spare time sila after fishing sa madaling araw.

segments.text: Pwede rin sila mag-aalaga ng hayop for their own communities, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari
segments.text: Ano lang po, Mr. Secretary, regarding po kayo sa cold storage, meron po kayang possibility na magkaroon tayo ng cold storage facilities?

segments.speaker: Rep. Carl Nicolas C. Cari

segments.text: yung reklamo po ng mga fisher folk, dahil nga walang cold storage na available para sa kanila, usually naubos na yung catch nila galing sa laot kasi nabibili ng mga buyers na nandun na sa Palawate.

segments.text: At di na nila nabababa sa Palawan mainland yung catch. At yung nagsasuffer po yung local economy kasi nga nababawasan na po yung availability ng fish.

segments.text: For 2027, Mr. Chair, meron kaming nasa budget namin na solar-powered ice plants na 5 to 10 tons per day na capacity.

segments.text: And medyo, ilan dun mapupunta talaga sa Palawan.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Tapos yung cold storage and freezers nandun sa gitna, dun sa may Puerto Princesa para yung fresh fish or seafoods nama may yelo,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: madadala natin sa blast freezing area, cold storage areas para ma-process.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: And madala sa tourist markets itin atin in Manila and everywhere.

segments.text: Ayun po yung general plan, Mr. Chair.

segments.text: Thank you po, Mr. Chair.
